shapeSummary: NEMA 14 stepper motor with the shaft along +Y. A 35.2 mm square body spans Y=0 to 28. A 22 mm diameter pilot boss, 2 mm tall, sits on the front face. A 5 mm round shaft rises from the front face (Y=28) to Y=49. Four 3 mm blind holes, 3 mm deep, sit on a 26 mm square pattern in the front face.
warnings: The 0.5 mm flat on the D-shaft is omitted because its length is not given, so the shaft is modeled as a plain cylinder.
The shaft is measured as 21 mm from the body front face, which gives 49 mm overall. The pilot boss is therefore only 2 mm of the shaft's 21 mm, and the shaft length from the boss face is 19 mm.
The hole diameter of 3 mm comes from the M3 callout, and the thread is not modeled. The 3 mm depth is assumed.
The lead wires, connector, label and the body's chamfered corners and lamination grooves are omitted.
The small center hole in the shaft end is not modeled because it is not clearly confirmed.
cadquery:
pl = cq.Plane(origin=(0, 0, 0), xDir=(1, 0, 0), normal=(0, 1, 0))
body = cq.Workplane(pl).rect(35.2, 35.2).extrude(28)
boss = cq.Workplane(pl).workplane(offset=28).circle(11).extrude(2)
shaft = cq.Workplane(pl).workplane(offset=28).circle(2.5).extrude(21)
pts = [(-13, -13), (13, -13), (-13, 13), (13, 13)]
holes = cq.Workplane(pl).workplane(offset=25).pushPoints(pts).circle(1.5).extrude(3)
part = body.union(boss).union(shaft).cut(holes)
